title: The Solar Eclipse
description: Adds a new event named Solar Eclipse.
body:
# Solar Eclipse

**This mod adds a new solar eclipse event. It occurs on specific days; you can use the command /solar eclipse next to find out when the next one will take place.**

![This is what the in-game event will look like.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00dab9a03145f3451388b88d1679afa4653ac27b.png)

**During a solar eclipse, it gets dark.**
![This mod adds a new solar eclipse event. It occurs on specific days; you can use the command /solar eclipse next to find out when the next one will take place.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ca8317248339bb78aa7105a2e607739560563af.png)

**During a solar eclipse, monsters no longer burn and can spawn during the day.**

![During a solar eclipse, mobs will no longer burn and can spawn during the day.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2990bdd9371e81597edb64d4f1d57f886f361978.png)

**During a solar eclipse, spiders behave as they do at night.**

![During a solar eclipse, the behavior of spiders also changes; instead of being passive during the day as usual, they become aggressive, just as they are at night.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/acbc50e647c05d87046705e0ebf71eab20c608d1.png)

**That was, in principle, everything I could tell you about it. Nevertheless, I hope you like the mod and have fun with it.**
